name: Day of Defeat
rootCause: Day of Defeat has rug pull, value has suddenly dropped by over 96%, and over $1.35 million in assets has been moved from BSC-based projects to external wallets. After the funds ran out, the project claimed they had been hacked by outside actors and had “reported to Binance and local authorities.”
